jsonld_raw.name: MINERAL BRISA EDT 100ML (3.4 FL. OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
MINERAL BRISA EDT 100ML (3.4 FL. OZ). A fluid and mineral fragrance inspired by light reflecting on the Mediterranean Sea. Exotic starfruit provides a juicy, luminous freshness that blends with the aquatic delicacy of lotus and a silky texture reminiscent of salty skin after the sea. Transparent yet sensual, the composition evolves into a soft, enveloping base that leaves a sophisticated and contemporary second-skin sensation. It evokes calm, freedom, and the luminous serenity of the Mediterranean coast.

Marine floral | Mineral, serene, and sophisticated.
